notes: This is a curated starter catalog, not the authoritative complete UNESCO registry.
Multi-component sites and protected areas cannot be represented accurately by a single point; use the point for map navigation only until boundaries are added.
Model target dimensions are planning metadata, not measured facts about the current GLB file. Inspect actual GLB bounds before using it for scale analysis.
Automated source datasets are stored separately under data/generated and must not overwrite curated designations, model paths, licence reviews, educational copy or coordinates.

GLB model placement mode 'detail' is intentionally used for the current Borobudur asset to isolate it from Cesium's renderer. Once validated or converted, a separate tested globe-model path can be enabled.

On-globe GLB models currently use a screen-projected Three.js overlay anchored to the WGS84 coordinate. This prevents the unverified Borobudur asset from entering Cesium's native glTF render loop. The overlay has no terrain occlusion and should be used on the OSM ellipsoid basemap until terrain support is added.
